prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: single building concept for Pilgrimage, an isometric medieval settlement game.
Primary request: one humble monks' relic hovel with a square 5 by 5 tile footprint, variant C "Pilgrim’s porch". A proper enclosed single-storey building with a steep continuous gabled roof of thick wheat-coloured thatch, irregular softly fringed eaves, warm limewashed daub walls, exposed dark oak posts and simple diagonal braces, a low footing of just one course of simple irregular grey stones, a recessed south entrance sheltered beneath the gable, supported by two porch posts, all tucked WITHIN the same square building footprint, two tiny shuttered windows, a tiny simple wooden cross over the lintel. A subdued golden glint deep inside the doorway indicates a relic. Roof is intact.
Style/medium: original hand-inked medieval history-book illustration. Confident slightly irregular dark brown pen contours, sparse grouped straw hatch marks and timber grain, flat restrained watercolour washes; readable large shapes. Friendly, practical vernacular construction. Palette: ink #352b24, plaster #e7d8b9, timber #715139, thatch #c4a05f, thatch shadow #927344, stone #a29c8b; muted blue-grey shadows.
Composition: one isolated building, orthographic three-quarter isometric camera from southeast, yaw45 and elevation35.264 degrees, verticals vertical, see south front and east side. Square image, entire building including footing in frame with 12 percent clear margin. No perspective convergence. All ornament remains inside the square footprint. Large building roughly 75 percent of image width.
Backdrop: plain uniform warm ivory #f3eddf. No ground island, no landscape, no cast shadow outside the footprint.
Avoid: text, labels, lettering, people, scenery, fences, glossy 3D, photorealism, gradients, pixel art, excessive fine hatching, cathedral features, roof opening, moat.
Critical visual direction: simple illustrated medieval village from a children's history book. Very light almost white plaster, pale straw, flat opaque watercolour. NO sepia tint, NO engraving texture, NO dense scratches. Roof middle mostly unmarked pale straw wash, just a few short dark pen strokes in loose groups at fringes. A handful of wobbly ink contours convey the whole thing. Keep abundant 12 percent margins.
